overriding-and-specialization.label: Overriding and Specialization
overriding-and-specialization.summary: Override inherited behavior by keeping the same public method name while a subclass supplies a more specific implementation.

try_overriding_and_specialization_sketch.title: Override label() on Book
try_overriding_and_specialization_sketch.prompt: `Book` already inherits from `CatalogItem`, and `main.py` is complete. In `models/book.py`, override the inherited `label(self)` method so a `Book` returns `Book: ` followed by that object's title. Keep the method name `label`, keep `Book` inheriting from `CatalogItem`, and leave `models/catalog_item.py` and `main.py` unchanged.
try_overriding_and_specialization_sketch.hint: Define `label(self)` inside `Book`. The child method should use `self.title` and return the specialized text.

help.concept: An override uses the same method name as the inherited method but provides subclass-specific behavior.

try_overriding_and_specialization_sketch.starterCode:
from models.book import Book

title = input()
book = Book(title)

print(book.label())

main_py.content:
from models.book import Book

title = input()
book = Book(title)

print(book.label())

models_book_py.content:

class Book(CatalogItem):

sc-overriding-purpose.title: Why override an inherited method?
sc-overriding-purpose.prompt: `CatalogItem.label()` returns only the title. Why should `Book` override `label()` instead of inventing a different method name?
sc-overriding-purpose.hint: The caller should keep using the same public behavior.

help.concept: Overriding preserves the inherited method contract while allowing the subclass to specialize its implementation.
help.hint_2: The child can return a more specific result.

options.b: To force callers to learn a new method name for every subclass
options.c: To keep the `label()` contract while giving `Book` book-specific behavior
options.d: To remove the title state inherited from `CatalogItem`

fb-overriding-method-name.title: Keep the inherited method name
fb-overriding-method-name.prompt: Complete the method name so `Book` overrides the method it inherits from `CatalogItem`.
fb-overriding-method-name.hint: An override uses the same method name as the parent.

help.concept: Python recognizes the subclass implementation as an override because it uses the same method name.

sc-overriding-shared-contract.title: Which label() runs?
sc-overriding-shared-contract.prompt: `CatalogItem.label()` returns `self.title`, while `Book.label()` returns `Book: ` plus the title. What does `Book("Coraline").label()` return?
sc-overriding-shared-contract.hint: Python looks on the subclass before falling back to the parent.

help.concept: When a subclass overrides a method, calls on that subclass use the subclass implementation.

options.d: Python raises an error because both classes define `label()`
